categories.main_business_segments: Nan Liu Enterprise Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the production and sales of non-woven fabrics including spunlace (water-jet) non-woven fabric, hot air and hot-pressed non-woven fabric, disposable surgical gown fabrics, hygiene products such as baby wet wipes, and skincare products like facial masks. The company also engages in industrial products such as abrasive wheels and household cleaning products, as well as medical devices manufacturing and sales. Additionally, it has diversified into cosmetics manufacturing, paper processing, and real estate development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced non-woven fabric technologies including spunlace (water-jet) and hot air bonding methods. It employs mechanical and thermal bonding techniques to produce high-quality non-woven fabrics with properties such as softness, elasticity, filtration, and biodegradability. The production process includes automated equipment and strict quality control systems, with certifications like ISO 9001, ISO 13485, and AAMI standards. Nan Liu also develops composite non-woven fabrics and environmentally friendly biodegradable materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nan Liu serves customers in the hygiene and medical sectors, supplying materials for baby diapers, adult incontinence products, sanitary napkins, surgical gowns, and medical masks. Its customers include major hygiene product manufacturers and distributors in Taiwan, China, Japan, India, and other Asian markets. The company also targets industrial clients requiring abrasive materials and filtration products, as well as consumers of skincare and cosmetic products through retail channels.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates manufacturing facilities in Taiwan (Kaohsiung), China (Zhejiang Province), and India (Ahmedabad, Gujarat). Its sales markets cover Taiwan, Mainland China, Japan, India, other Asian countries, and expanding into Middle East and African markets. Nan Liu maintains a strong export orientation with over 50% of sales generated from international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nan Liu operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and processing of non-woven fabrics and related hygiene and medical products. It sources raw materials such as polypropylene fibers and viscose cotton from upstream suppliers and supplies finished fabrics and products to downstream hygiene product manufacturers and distributors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D to develop functional and high-value-added non-woven fabrics, including elastic composites, biodegradable materials, and medical-grade products. It collaborates with domestic and international research institutions to enhance production technology and product quality. Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity, automation, supply chain integration, and sustainability initiatives such as energy efficiency and carbon reduction.
categories.revenue_model: Nan Liu generates revenue primarily through product sales of non-woven fabrics, hygiene products (wet wipes, diapers), medical protective materials, and skincare cosmetics. Sales are made to industrial clients, distributors, and retail channels. The company also earns income from its subsidiaries and overseas operations through equity method investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nan Liu competes with domestic companies such as Connaissance, Shinli, and Hengda in the non-woven fabric and hygiene product sectors. It holds a leading market position in Taiwan with higher consolidated revenues than these peers. Globally, it ranks 23rd in non-woven fabric sales according to industry publications, positioning it as a significant Asian player with a focus on quality and product differentiation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, Nan Liu reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$6.7 billion, representing an 8.68% growth over the prior year. Net profit after tax was about NT$100 million, a slight decline due to increased costs and competitive pressures. The company maintains total assets around NT$10.25 billion and shareholders' equity of NT$3.64 billion, with steady cash flow from operations and ongoing capital investments in new facilities and equipment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nan Liu differentiates itself through high-quality, certified non-woven fabrics with superior softness, elasticity, and functional properties tailored for medical and hygiene applications. Its products meet stringent international standards (ISO, AAMI, EN certifications) and emphasize environmental sustainability with biodegradable materials and responsible supply chain management. The company’s integrated R&D and production capabilities enable customized solutions and reliable supply, fostering strong customer loyalty.
